remove.title: Remove US influence
remove.desc: Remove all US influence from up to 4 countries in Eastern Europe.
remove.verb: removes US influence from Eastern Europe

add.title: Add USSR influence
add.desc: Add 5 USSR influence in Eastern Europe (at most 2 per country).
add.verb: adds USSR influence in Eastern Europe

participate.title: Participate
participate.desc: Both roll a die, the sponsor +2; the higher roll gains 2 VP.

boycott.title: Boycott
boycott.desc: DEFCON degrades by 1 and the sponsor conducts 4 Ops.

end.title: End the game
end.desc: Give the opponent 6 VP, then the game ends and is scored as it stands.
end.verb: ends the game, giving the opponent 6 VP

chernobyl.title: {{region}}
chernobyl.desc: The USSR may not place influence in {{region}} with Ops for the rest of the turn.

defcon.endsGame: DEFCON 1 ends the game: the phasing player loses.
